The following events took place in '''23 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*Many [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]] fled to [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]].
*12:9&mdash;[[Domitree]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Ord Thoden]], was devastated by an [[Groundquake/Legends|earthquake]].<ref name="Hnn-Jedi Refuse to Hand Over Baby Ludi">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|jediwatch/1337_1.html|Jedi Refuse to Hand Over Baby Ludi}}</ref>
*12:9&mdash;A [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Lasro Javeq]] exploded in the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet Complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manda/Legends|Manda]].<ref name="HNN47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|business/13314_2.html|XTS Cleared in Freighter Explosion}}</ref>
*13:0&mdash;A three-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] investigation into the improprieties of [[Halcor Raystel]], the Dean of the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]], began.<ref name="Hnn-Dean of Aldera Suspended">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|life/13314_2.html|Dean of Aldera Suspended}}</ref>
*13:1&mdash;A diplomatic envoy consisting of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Ludwin Katarkus]] and [[Everen Ettene]], along with their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Danyawarra]] and [[Halagad Ventor]], leaves [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to broker peace talks in the [[Virgillian Civil War]].<ref name="Virgillia" />
*13:1:7&mdash;The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] quit shipping food to [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]] due to increased [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] taxation on the [[Sharlissian Trade Corridor]].<ref name="Hnn-Riots Rock Kabal">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_3.html|Riots Rock Kabal}}</ref>
*13:1:14&mdash;''[[Gunray On Top]]'' and ''[[Holding Back the Tide]]'', the separate biographies of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] and former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] were both published.<ref name="Hnn-Valorum & Gunray Bracket Ends of Book Sales">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|life/13314_3.html|Valorum & Gunray Bracket Ends of Book Sales}}</ref>
*13:2:25&mdash;[[Slicer/Legends|Slicers]] attacked the networks of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="Hnn-HoloNet News is Back and Secure">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_5.html|HoloNet News is Back and Secure}}</ref>
*13:2&mdash;The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Chief Representative Officer]] [[Hoolidan Keggle]] criticized [[TriPlanetary Press/Legends|TriPlanetary Press]], the publishers of the ''[[Encyclopedia Galactica]]'', during his [[State of the Union address]].<ref name="Hnn-Duros Dispute Encyclopedia">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|regional/13228_2.html|Duros Dispute Encyclopedia}}</ref>
*13:2&mdash;[[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] was banned on [[Caprioril]].<ref name="Hnn-Podracing Banned on Caprioril">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|sports/13228_2.html|Podracing Banned on Caprioril}}</ref>
*13:2&mdash;The arrest of [[Denlace Sachoore]] led to a discovery of a corporate thievery outbreak in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]].<ref name="Hnn-Corporate Alliance Attacks Slicer Compound">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|business/13321_1.html|Corporate Alliance Attacks Slicer Compound}}</ref>
*13:2&mdash;An assault on a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] passenger [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] over one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] resulted in 215 Wookiee [[Death/Legends|casualties]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] used his position to [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] trade to Trandosha until the bodies of the passengers could be returned to Kashyyyk for proper burial.<ref name="HNN48:133211">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|regional/13321_1.html|Kashyyyk/Trandoshan Talks to Shaky Start}}</ref>
*13:2&mdash;The [[People's Inquest]] set up a temporary camp outside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Hnn-People's Inquest Demand Jedi Budget Reports">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|jediwatch/13321_1.html|People's Inquest Demand Jedi Budget Reports}}</ref>
*13:2&mdash;The [[Sepan Civil War]] came to a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]-long standstill.<ref name="Sepan" />
*13:2&mdash;An unregistered bounty posting, offering 1 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] million for the delivery of the remains of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], is discovered on a public [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] [[Datanet/Legends|datanet]].<ref name="HNN46:13372">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|news/1337_2.html|Army Vote Prompts Chandrilan Public Safety Walk-out}}</ref>
*13:2:25&mdash;[[Razelfiin]] is selected by lottery as the leader of [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]].<ref name="HNN53:134252">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|regional/13425_2.html|Tynna to Secede Following Building Disappearance}}</ref>
*13:2:27&mdash;During a gala fundraiser in the [[Jrade District/Legends|Jrade District]] of Coruscant, [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] Representative [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] destroys an elaborate ice statue.<ref name="HNN45:132283">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_3.html|Rep. Binks Destroys Ice Statue at Gala Fundraiser}}</ref> During a live interview on the [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] talk show ''[[Essence]]'', [[Stark Veteran Assembly]] spokesman [[Laslo Dorits]] criticizes [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="HNN45:132284">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_4.html|Stark Veterans Blast Amidala}}</ref>
*13:2:28&mdash;[[Ando/Legends|Ando]] and [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] formally secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with their respective Senators [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]] and [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] issuing their resignations via [[Droid/Legends|droid]] proxy during a morning session of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Within hours, anti-Republic protestors celebrate the separation in [[Quantill City]], Ando,<ref name="HNN45:n132281" /> and over 500 [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] arrange for passage off of Coruscant.<ref name="HNN45:132282">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_2.html|Mass Aqualish Exodus Expected}}</ref>
*By this time, the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] has established an office on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Final Showdown">''[[Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown]]''</ref>
*[[Ferus Olin]] resigns from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Final Showdown" /> He eventually ends up living on the world of [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]] where he starts a good friendship with [[Roan Lands]].

==Births==
*[[Kyle Katarn]]<ref name="Kyle">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' establishes that [[Kyle Katarn]] joined the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] at age eighteen, and ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'' states that Katarn spent four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] at the Academy. As ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' establishes ''Dark Forces''{{'s}} date as [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a birth date of 23 BBY can be found.</ref>

*[[R5-D4/Legends|R5-D4]]<ref name="R5-D4">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|business/13228_3.html|IA Pulls R5's Plug}} established that the [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] discontinued the [[R5-series astromech droid]] on 13:2:28 of the [[Great ReSynchronization calendar]], which corresponds to 23 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]]. Since ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'' states that [[R5-D4/Legends|R5-D4]] was one of the last [[Droid/Legends|droid]]s produced Industrial Automaton R5 line, R5-D4 built in 23 BBY.</ref>
